rationale: The plan identifies the condition:time interaction correctly and specifies the DESeq2 LRT of ~condition+time+condition:time against ~condition+time with time as a categorical 4-level factor, which is exactly the reference approach; per-time-point condition contrasts are added to characterize the trajectories, and the small n=3 per cell power caveat is stated. QC is concrete and dataset-specific (VST PCA colored by condition and shaped by time, sample-distance heatmap, sample-ID matching, outlier flagging rather than silent removal), though library-size/depth inspection is not mentioned. The low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, justified by the smallest design cell) and normalization handling (raw counts into DESeq2, size factors internal, VST only for visualization) are both exemplary. The weakest point is multiple-testing/shrinkage: padj < 0.05 is stated but BH is never named, and no lfcShrink or equivalent is applied to the reported per-time-point fold changes; ordering the time factor could also alter contrast coding and the reference level for condition is only implied. Enrichment is appropriate and well-specified (fgsea ranked by the LRT statistic, ORA universe = tested genes, human WikiPathways, fallback if absent) but lacks a collection version and gene-set size window.
